verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automations that run in the background: continuous monitoring, alerts and automated evidence collection, continuous risk monitoring, and pre-mapped automated workflows. Users can also build their own ingestion workflows, including through an AI Editor driven by natural-language prompts, and feed them via webhooks. Its GitHub compliance skills fire 'without being asked', which points to autonomous agent-side automation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on user-defined triggers, schedules and autonomous execution of custom workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run unattended as claimed.
